title: FOUNDATIONS OF MATHEMATICS
description: Introduces proof writing and focuses on elementary logic and set theory, quantifiers, proof techniques (including mathematical induction), equivalence relations, and functions. Topics include recurrence relations, generating functions, the binomial theorem, and cardinality of sets.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: MTH 253* or 253Z*.
* May be taken concurrently.
A minimum grade of C- is required in MTH 253 and MTH 253Z.
books_html: No-cost: Course utilizes open educational resources, materials available through the library, or does not require any purchased materials.
meeting_html: MWF 10am-10:50am in STAG 111 - Strand Agriculture Hall 111 (GP) (9/23 to 12/4)
